approvalMessage.text:
APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 46 Chapter 604
 
      MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 1080-B, entitled:
 
    "AN  ACT  to amend the executive law, in relation to the appointment
        for agricultural representation on the state fire prevention and
        building code council"
 
    APPROVED
 
  The bill would expand the size of the State Fire Prevention and Build-
ing Code Council (Code Council) by one member, who shall represent agri-
cultural producers.
 
  I support the goals of the bill. Because  the  Code  Council  performs
such important work developing and maintaining safe and efficient build-
ing  and  construction  standards,  it is imperative that its membership
reflect a diversity of interests. However, the bill, as  drafted,  would
lead  to  an  even  number of members and, thus, the potential for dead-
locked votes.  Changes were necessary to appoint one more member to help
avoid tied votes.
 
  I have reached an agreement with the Legislature to enact these chang-
es.  On the basis of this agreement, I am pleased to sign this bill.
 
  This bill is approved.                         (signed) KATHY HOCHUL
 
                                ______
